steps.rule: Apply exactly one rescue axis to TrendMA/MACD. Preserve baseline. If no economic improvement, demote to donor-only.
Failed TrendMA/MACD rescue cannot remain a Top6 promotion candidate; retain only as synthesis material.
Restore material nursery so grade-C donors combine with each other before touching Top5 hosts.
C x C material-child must pass independent economic checks before grade B. Only grade B may feed Top5 hosts.
Run exit-only RR grid in shadow. Do not mutate frozen Top5 parents or G5 TrendRider Broad30.
Promotion requires trade-count retention, WR non-decrease, net PnL/expectancy/PF/payoff non-decrease, DD non-increase.
